extracted.subtask_description: News articles and dispatches reporting on post‑World War II international events, UN/ diplomatic developments, and regional conflicts, written for a general newspaper audience and often distributed by news agencies (AP/Gannett).

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondent registration requirement
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authorities require foreign correspondents to register in order to furnish them the information they require in the discharge of their duties; credentials and convenient guarantees are to be issued showing presence and affiliations. (Surrounding text: 'AUTHORITIES OF THEIR . PRESENCE AND AFFILIATIONS. ... THEY REQUIRE IN THE DISCHARGE OF THEIR DUTIES AND GRANT CONVENIENT GUARANTEES AND ISSUE THEM RESPECTIVE CREDENTIALS.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Licensing criteria for export of embargoed coal sizes
rubrics_metrics.description: Embargoed sizes can be licensed for shipment abroad only in certain circumstances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individual cargoes of embargoed 'lump and double‑screened' coal may be licensed when it is 'conclusively shown that serious loss of efficiency abroad would result from enforced use of substitutes,' or when the sizes are in surplus supply in individual producing fields in the United States. (Context: embargo intended to assure domestic supplies; most of this coal is rarely shipped because of breakage in shipment.)
